testimonials.text: The most interesting aspect of this online course was learning about tranexamic acid, especially its mechanism of action in controlling bleeding and its wide range of clinical applications such as trauma, surgery, and obstetric hemorrhage. I also found it valuable to understand when it should and should not be used in different clinical situations.
It has been great taking this course. It refreshed my knowledge about the use of TXA.
Cały temat był interesujący i przydatny w pracy ratownika medycznego.

It provided a clear understanding of the clinical applications of tranexamic acid in trauma, peri-operative care, obstetrics, orthopaedics, and critical care settings. The most engaging aspects were: the mechanism of action of tranexamic acid and its role in fibrinolysis; evidence from major clinical trials in trauma and post-partum haemorrhage; practical dosing protocols and safety considerations; its expanding applications in surgery and emergency medicine.

The fact that tranexamic acid has anti-inflammatory effects and reduces the SIRS was nice to know. Also, since it is safe for breastfeeding, if there is PPH after delivery of the baby, I could prescribe it to those mothers.
All the course was relevant. I mostly enjoyed knowing the different uses of TXA and the side effects of that product as well.
